column3: three friends ask for a place; one tick of the host admits all three
bundle: bundles/romero  (send it privately; it holds the player's key and a join token that works until the node registers or 8 min pass)
namespace: play-romero  (the bundle's kubeconfig works there only, until 4500s from now)
bundle: bundles/carmack  (send it privately; it holds the player's key and a join token that works until the node registers or 8 min pass)
namespace: play-carmack  (the bundle's kubeconfig works there only, until 4500s from now)
bundle: bundles/petersen  (send it privately; it holds the player's key and a join token that works until the node registers or 8 min pass)
namespace: play-petersen  (the bundle's kubeconfig works there only, until 4500s from now)
tick: auto on | expelled 0 | approved 3 | slots 3/3 used | 0 in the list (0 eligible now)
the host's tick: both consents, both namespaces live, so it opens the party
tick: auto on | expelled 0 | approved 0 | slots 3/3 used | 0 in the list (0 eligible now)
a second party, romero and petersen: another pair, another policy
tick: auto on | expelled 0 | approved 0 | slots 3/3 used | 0 in the list (0 eligible now)
romero's server is the witness: who connected, joined and left, and when, with frags and deaths
[17:18:19] Masters will not be contacted because sv_usemasters is 0
tick: auto on | expelled 0 | approved 0 | slots 3/3 used | 0 in the list (0 eligible now)
party: romero -> carmack: closed: carmack left the party
the host's own machine joins (trust own, not the control plane): the host can now have a watcher, watch-host
watcher: namespace watch-host ready; its pods run on: hostpc
the host asks romero to let it watch: its half of a party, like any player's invite
watcher: asked romero; the party opens when romero runs: edge-mesh party accept watch-host
party: watch-host -> romero: waiting for romero to accept
tick: auto on | expelled 0 | approved 0 | slots 3/3 used | 0 in the list (0 eligible now)
watcher: spectator of romero's game, following romero (pod doom-watch-romero in watch-host; frames: mesh host watch frame romero)
romero's server names the host's spectator: nobody is watched without a line saying who came in
kubectl exec -n play-romero doom-server -- grep 'watch-host has connected' /tmp/server.log
the host's frames come through the API server to its own pod: nothing new listens, the mesh carries no frame for the host
the host's views have a cap: watch-host's quota. Lowered to what runs now, one more spectator is refused by the API server
party: romero -> watch-host: closed: watch-host left the party
watcher: stopped the spectator of romero
kubectl exec -n play-romero doom-server -- grep 'petersen joined the game' /tmp/server.log
game: romero's server starting (pod doom-server, Service doom 10666/UDP in play-romero; the image must be on romero's node)
the house match: the host's own Doom game on its own machine, two robots in it, and its spectator. This is what the live page shows
house: namespace house ready (closed: nobody is offered a party yet); its pods run on: hostpc
house: the match runs (server, robots robot-a and robot-b, the spectator doom-watch-house following robot-a; frames: mesh host house frame)
the streamer pushes the house's frames to the public page; the page keeps the last one, in memory, and anyone can watch
mesh host live start --url https://<the public page>
the host opens the house: every player is offered a party with it, and told it is broadcast
party: house -> carmack: offered (the house match is broadcast; carmack accepts with: edge-mesh party accept house)
party: house -> petersen: offered (the house match is broadcast; petersen accepts with: edge-mesh party accept house)
party: house -> romero: offered (the house match is broadcast; romero accepts with: edge-mesh party accept house)
house: open - every player is offered a party with the house (broadcast on the live page); each accepts with: edge-mesh party accept house
kubectl exec -n house doom-server -- grep 'joined the game' /tmp/server.log
party: house -> carmack: closed: the house match is closed
party: house -> petersen: closed: the house match is closed
party: house -> romero: closed: the house match is closed
party: petersen -> house: closed: the house match is closed; accept again to play when it reopens
house: closed - the offers are withdrawn and the parties with the house closed
panic: the house's broadcast stops at once with everything else
